heading: Closing Shift
intro: The depot is quiet this late. Everything here is counted, and everything counted belongs to somebody. What you do about that is the shift.

objectives.instruction: Take in the loading dock and its exits
Speak with Priya about the shift
Look over the supply room north: the register, the tool crib, and Dana watching both
Take a shim card from the tool crib, then pick the lock on the storeroom door east of it
Meet Otis at the end of the service alley east; he buys things without asking where they came from
